body: This episode looks at why storms, floods and heatwaves seem to be hitting harder and more often around the world.
这期节目探讨：为什么全球的暴风雨、洪水和热浪似乎越来越猛烈、越来越频繁。
A BBC weather expert explains how scientists link these disasters to a warming planet, and what 'climate change' really means in daily life.
一位 BBC 气象专家解释了科学家如何把这些灾害与日益变暖的地球联系起来，以及'气候变化'在日常生活里到底意味着什么。
You will learn clear vocabulary about weather, risk and the environment that appears in today's news.
你会学到关于天气、风险和环境的清晰词汇，这些词常出现在今天的新闻里。
tips: 把 A 和 B 联系起来

body: This programme asks why English has so few words for smells compared with words for colours or tastes.
这期节目探讨：为什么英语里形容气味的词，比形容颜色或味道的词少那么多。
Neil and Georgie discuss funny examples and explain that we often borrow words from other senses to talk about smell.
Neil 和 Georgie 讨论了一些有趣的例子，并说明我们常借用其他感官的词来描述气味。
You will learn useful adjectives and phrases for describing scents in everyday conversation.
你会学到在日常对话中形容气味的有用形容词和短语。

articles.en: Sharing the road with driverless cars
body: This episode explores how self-driving cars are already moving through some city streets without a human driver.
这期节目探讨：无人驾驶汽车已经怎样在一些城市街道上，没有人类司机也能行驶。
Phil and Pippa discuss whether people will trust these 'robotaxis' and how we can safely share the road with them.
Phil 和 Pippa 讨论了人们是否会信任这些'机器人出租车'，以及我们怎样和它们安全共处。
You will learn vocabulary about technology, safety and transport that is useful for talking about AI in daily life.
你会学到关于科技、安全和交通的词汇，对聊日常生活中的 AI 很有用。
tips: 机器人出租车（无人驾驶出租车）

body: This programme is for anyone who feels nervous when they have to speak English out loud.
这期节目献给所有一开口说英语就紧张的人。
Beth and Pippa share why this fear is normal and give simple ways to practise speaking without pressure.
Beth 和 Pippa 分享了这种害怕为什么很正常，并给出几种没有压力就能练口语的简单方法。
You will learn friendly phrases to encourage yourself and others when learning to speak a new language.
你会学到在学一门新语言时，鼓励自己与他人的实用短语。
This episode looks at why riding a bike can be good for both our health and the environment.
这期节目探讨：为什么骑自行车对我们的健康和环境都好。
Neil and Becca discuss a plan to get more people cycling and the small changes that make cities bike-friendly.
Neil 和 Becca 讨论了一个让更多人骑车的方案，以及让城市更适合骑车的小改变。
You will learn everyday vocabulary about transport, exercise and city life.
你会学到关于交通、运动和城市生活的日常词汇。
tips: 适合骑车的、对自行车友好的
